message.content:
The user now needs to enter the specified message "Gym membership renewal due on the 20th." in the input box. The current interface's EditText is "Type a message…", so the input box is already focused (or will be focused after clicking), and the Type action is executed to input the text. It is important to ensure the input box is activated, and then enter the content. Therefore, this step performs the Type action to input the specified message text.


do(action="Type", text="Gym membership renewal due on the 20th.")
